notes.title: Solenars Edge Heroes Final Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32615812/a76525d0d5fc1616a89493953b987ce44de00114.png[/img]


I want to say a very special thank you to those who have played/purchased Solenars Edge Heroes.


I wish this could have been a real update, but I don't have the actual files anymore. I've been through a bunch of different computers since the creation of this game years ago. So they are long gone. But, I appreciate those who have played it and I hope there will still be those who continue to play it.

notes.title: Solenars Edge Heroes v1.6 Update!
notes.notes:
This update is rather small, but it's better then nothing.

Here is what has changed;

-Archieves Rank added in. The final rank for the Arena which ends everything.
-Stat Changes.
-Yenta's sprite turned into Master Yenta's sprite in the Hall of Heroes.
-Some hidden secrets added.

Enjoy~

notes.title: Solenars Edge Heroes v1.5 Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615812/63197838bd667bfe72e9f168543ba5ca66702bcf.png[/img]
*Image is of the original Solenars Edge Logo from several years ago.*

Hello again, I recently went through a play-through of Solenars Edge Heroes while my internet was gone and I noticed a few things needed fixing. I also added in a few new things. Please take a look.~

-Decreased the amount of actions that can be taken in battle from 20 to 11 to increase the difficulty.

-Added in a secret area on top of the pyramid outside the Arena.

-Fixed missing enemies from certain fights.

-Added in a new rank; Deatherem Rank with two new enemies.

-Fixed Goddess Alnestia so that she is able to be hired as a Mercenary.

-Added in Master Yoskei as a Mercenary as he was planned but forgotten.

-Changed the main character's max level from 40 to 50. This was an error.

-Added in two new companions; A wolf named Xion and a Neko named Peppita.

-Added in the option to double check your name before confirming.

-Changed the amount of letters from 8 to 12 for naming your character.

*It's also important to know that extra options can be accessed by pressing F1. Options selected with these will be carried out during your next launch. It may conflict with some of the in-game options so be sure to look at those again.*

notes.title: Solenars Edge Heroes Hotfix v1.2!
notes.notes:
Sorry to announce that during my busy working, I let slip some glitches that made things either better or worse for some players. Anyhow I fixed them and hopefully they won't bother people again.

-Got rid of time mode in the Ultima Rank fight.
-Removed the insane amount of Kacha you received on accident at the start of a new save file.
-Added in new weapons, armor and accessories.
-Buffed some equipment to make it stronger in the long run.

*Hope you continue to have a wonderful steam sale!

PS: For those of you who enjoy Solenars Edge Heroes gameplay, but desire story. There is already a game for that and it is called Solenars Edge Rebirth.
Check it out here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/679470/Solenars_Edge_Rebirth/

notes.title: Solenars Edge Heroes v1.2 Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615812/d83d75192e7c94ff980e8fb00cb049544cc3142b.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone and welcome to Solenars Edge Heroes Update v1.2!
In this update I decided to focus on adding a lot of neat stuff.
Let us jump in shall we?


-Added in the ability to jump by pressing the "A" button on your keyboard.
-Added in the Half-Dragon, Half Human race; Algorian.
-Added in two more selectable characters per race in the character selection menu.
-Added in Athello. Athello are in short bracelets that can be worn in the shield slot to increase the user's stats.
-Changed the Interface and U.I.
-Added in Garden of The Slyphs and put the fishing spot there alongside the boat.
-Added in a hangout spot with a space invaders like mini-game.
-Added in an Army Manager area that allows you to look at all your mercenaries from afar and organize them as you please. You can swap them out or kick them from the party to make room for other units.
-Added in a new tier called the Nightmare. It has 3 new ranks with an array of new monsters/music.
-Raised the level cap from 20 to 30.
-You can now use 10 party members in battle instead of 8.
-The contest winners have been added as mercenary contracts.
-Some hidden goodies.
-You can tell when new items are added to your inventory.
-You can turn the party train off and on when you want by interacting with the stray pot by the crystal doors.
-The maximum amount of actions you can take per turn has increased from 10 to 20.

Luvocious DLCish is released. If you own Luvocious and like my work and would like to see better improvements on my games in the future. Please consider donating through this DLC or in the community hubs. However, it is completely optional.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/868990/Luvocious__Donation_Small/
